task.description: Fix syntax and logical bugs in a C++ template to compute the length of the longest path in a tree where no two adjacent nodes have the same character.
task.domain: Tree Algorithms / Dynamic Programming on Trees

solution.approach: Utilized Depth-First Search (DFS) on the rooted tree. For each node, recursively evaluated valid child subtrees whose characters differed from the current node's character. Maintained the top two longest branch lengths among valid children, updated a global maximum path length using 1 + longest + second_longest, and returned 1 + longest to the caller.
key_ideas: DFS recursion returning maximum single-branch path length to the parent node
Tracking top two longest valid child paths at each node to calculate combined path length through the node
Filtering adjacent child nodes with identical character values during DFS traversal
